events.description: A man in a black shirt and cap is seen pointing a handgun directly at another person in the crowd; his arm is extended and posture indicates active aiming/firing.

Following the apparent shooting, individuals in the crowd move rapidly toward the shooter and the targeted area, with physical contact and grappling visible among several people near the center of the group.

The crowd becomes highly agitated and mobile, with multiple groups moving erratically, some raising arms, others running or confronting each other; sustained chaotic movement and clustering suggest collective violent unrest beyond a single altercation.

Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat: one in a black hoodie and denim shorts throws punches at another in a black jacket and jeans, who defends and counters; others surround them, some filming, while a third person in red sleeves gestures toward the fight.

Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat: one in a black jacket and jeans lifts and grapples the other (in black hoodie and denim shorts), who is bent over and resisting; the interaction involves repeated lifting, holding, and struggling with no clear dominance, consistent with mutual fighting.

A large group of people (15+), many wearing masks and black clothing, surrounds and actively engages in or observes violent physical confrontation; multiple individuals gesture aggressively, some hold objects (e.g., guitar case, bottle), and the overall scene shows collective unrest with coordinated hostile behavior beyond a simple brawl.

Two men engage in mutual physical combat in the street: one wearing a black jacket, jeans, and green gloves (left) and another bald man in a black shirt and light blue shorts (right). The fight progresses from initial posturing and feinting (f0–f8) to direct grappling and takedowns (f9–f15), with the bald man eventually taking the other to the ground and holding him down.

Two men in the foreground engage in a mutual physical confrontation: one bald man in a black jacket and jeans repeatedly throws punches toward a man in a dark hoodie and jeans, who blocks and counters. The exchange continues across multiple frames with clear arm extension, impact gestures, and defensive postures, indicating active combat.
Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat across the street; participants punch, grapple, and push each other, with some falling and others intervening or joining the fray.

A person is on the ground (visible in f0–f2) while others stand over them and gesture aggressively; one individual in black points directly at the prone person, suggesting targeted aggression toward a helpless victim.

Large group of people (20+ visible) engaged in chaotic, violent clashes across a street intersection, with multiple simultaneous fights, aggressive posturing, and coordinated group actions indicating collective violent unrest.

Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat in the street: a person in a green shirt is tackled and held down by several others while others punch, shove, and grapple around them. The struggle involves at least 5–6 people actively exchanging blows or restraining each other.

A person in a green shirt remains on the ground, restrained by multiple individuals who continue to strike or press down on them while they are unable to defend themselves. This constitutes abuse of a helpless victim.

A large group (20+ people) engages in coordinated violent confrontation across the street, with multiple simultaneous fights, aggressive posturing, pointing, and movement toward opponents—characteristic of collective violent unrest rather than isolated scuffles.

A man in a black jacket and cap (foreground) extends his arm and appears to strike or push another individual who is recoiling backward; the motion is visible across frames f0–f2, with clear contact or near-contact at f1–f2.

A large group of individuals, many wearing masks and dark clothing, are engaged in coordinated aggressive posturing, advancing, and gesturing toward an unseen target; some raise fists or arms, others move rapidly across the street; the collective behavior exceeds peaceful protest and indicates violent unrest.
